# Yong Bai (白勇)

> Algorithm Engineer at Alibaba. M.Sc. from Nanjing University (LAMDA Group), B.Sc. from Beihang University.

## About

Yong Bai is an Algorithm Engineer at Alibaba, focused on large-scale computational advertising algorithms for Taobao Display Advertising (Alimama). Previously worked at Kuaishou (2023-2025) on computational advertising. He received his M.Sc. in Computer Science from Nanjing University, where he was a member of the LAMDA Group supervised by Prof. Zhi-Hua Zhou, and his B.Sc. from Beihang University (GPA: 3.86, Top 1%).

## Research Interests

- Machine Learning
- Data Mining
- Weakly Supervised Learning
- Online Distribution Shift
- Recommendation Systems
- Click-Through Rate Prediction

## Selected Publications

- MAC: A Conversion Rate Prediction Benchmark Featuring Labels Under Multiple Attribution Mechanisms (KDD 2026)
- EST: Towards Efficient Scaling Laws in Click-Through Rate Prediction via Unified Modeling (KDD 2026)
- Handling New Class in Online Label Shift (ICDM 2023)
- Capturing Conversion Rate Fluctuation during Sales Promotions: A Novel Historical Data Reuse Approach (KDD 2023)
- Adapting to Online Label Shift with Provable Guarantees (NeurIPS 2022)
- Fake Generated Painting Detection via Frequency Analysis (ICIP 2020)
